SUAS funding: FNAS transfers, account balances and IGD-M

Source: R/dados.R
mds_suas_financiamento.Rd

Shortcut for mds_data() with the curated funding fields (mds_fields("suas_financiamento")).

mds_suas_financiamento(periods = NULL, localities = "BR", fields = NULL)

Arguments

periods

Periods to fetch:

  • NULL (default): the last 12 months up to the current month;

  • a negative number -n: the last n months up to the current month;

  • years (2024) and/or months as YYYYMM (202401, "202401").

localities

"BR" (all of Brazil), state abbreviations ("PE") or 2-digit state codes (26), and/or 6- or 7-digit IBGE municipality codes (2611606), in any combination. Default "BR".

fields

Fields to fetch. NULL (default) fetches every curated field of the theme.

Value

A tibble in the format of mds_data().

Details

The transfer components add up to suas_repasse_mun_vl_total_fundo_f (checked for Pernambuco in 06/2026 and 09/2026). The account balances do not add up to the general total, so they should be read one by one.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
mds_suas_financiamento(periods = 2025, localities = 2611606)
}
